rationale: The user concern is continuous drift between an onboarded install and current platform expectations, not only a discrete package version event.
Every reconciliation area needs a baseline. Without a snapshot, reconcile check would be another doctor sweep with different branding.

decision: Keep security posture audit in doctor, not reconcile.
rationale: Security checks describe current safety properties. Reconciliation compares current expectations to a prior local anchor. Mixing them would create a kitchen-sink command.

decision: Default dashboard path is static build/open, not long-running serve.
rationale: A local HTTP server adds port/process lifecycle and localhost exposure. Static artifacts match the existing install-report posture and can later grow into serve mode if demand appears.

decision: Ship R0 and R1 in one executable child plan.
rationale: Capability drift is the first useful consumer of the install snapshot and is directly layered on the completed capability roadmap. R2-R4 remain future trigger-gated milestones.

decision: Roadmap close-out — R0 and R1 shipped via child plan 2026-05-23-002.
rationale: R0 (install snapshot primitive) and R1 (capability drift reconciliation) landed as features F001 and F002 of child plan 2026-05-23-002-feat-install-reconcile-foundation-v0. F001 (commit 7fc3144) added scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/install_snapshot.py with the typed snapshot model, deterministic fingerprints, secret-free schema, file mode 0600 writer, the `dontpanic init` post-walk/smoke hook, and the `dontpanic reconcile baseline [--profile=<name>] [--yes] [--format=text|json]` preview-by-default CLI; 15 focused tests in tests/test_install_snapshot_f001.py. F002 (commit 3104e3e) added the read-only `dontpanic reconcile check [--area=capabilities] [--format=text|json]` comparison surface in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/reconcile.py covering missing_snapshot / new_capabilities / removed_capabilities / changed_capabilities / stale_status_cache with exact-next-command nudges; 19 focused tests in tests/test_reconcile_check_f002.py. Combined targeted suite: 34 passed; sanitization clean across 1733 files; both plans `plan audit` non-blocking (goal_type=infra not in gated set). Close-out evidence: child evidence/closeout-memo-F001.md, evidence/closeout-memo-F002.md, evidence/closeout-memo-F003.md. R2 (config + agent manifest drift), R3 (MCP tool drift), and R4 (dashboard reconciliation view) remain documented future child plans gated on the explicit triggers in plan.md — NOT silently folded into v0. With R0/R1 implemented and operator-verified, this roadmap closes as a tracking parent; new reconciliation areas open fresh child plans when their triggers fire.
